name: COOKING_METHOD
description: Thermal, mechanical, or biochemical food preparation methods that modulate micronutrient bioavailability, anti-nutrient degradation (phytates, tannins), and infant textural suitability.

seed_examples.text: Sprouting and fermenting pulses enhances iron and zinc bioavailability in infant porridges.
seed_examples.clinical_notes: Degrades phytates bound to dietary iron.

seed_examples.text: Provide steamed and mashed vegetables during early complementary feeding to prevent choking.
Boiled eggs and pressure cooked lentils are easy for toddlers to digest.

downstream_rag_use: Anti-nutrient reduction guidelines, bio-availability optimization, and weaning texture safety.

name: SUPPLEMENT
description: Exogenous pharmaceutical or clinical therapeutic micronutrient preparations, drops, syrups, tablets, and therapeutic foods prescribed for prevention or treatment of pediatric malnutrition.

seed_examples.text: Infants diagnosed with severe anemia require pediatric iron drops alongside vitamin C rich fruits.
Administer zinc supplementation and ORS solution immediately during acute pediatric diarrhea.
seed_examples.clinical_notes: WHO clinical protocol for pediatric diarrhea recovery.

seed_examples.text: Children with severe acute malnutrition are managed with ready-to-use therapeutic food (RUTF).

downstream_rag_use: Clinical dosage verification, posology safety alerts, and acute SAM/diarrhea management.

name: DIET_PATTERN
description: Systemic dietary models, feeding regimens, and nutritional paradigms characterizing overall food intake variety and structure.

seed_examples.text: Achieving dietary diversity across at least five food groups daily prevents hidden hunger in toddlers.
seed_examples.clinical_notes: WHO Minimum Dietary Diversity score metric.

seed_examples.text: A balanced diet containing all essential macro and micronutrients is vital during the first 1000 days.

downstream_rag_use: Dietary diversity compliance scoring, meal plan balance evaluation.
